title: AP Labs scheduled jobs
description: A fork's scheduled jobs: <app>/jobs.json, a list of entries. Checked at startup even when jobs are off. Unknown keys are errors. See kit/templates/job.md.

name.description: A unique kebab-case slug, used in every log line.

schedule.description: Five-field cron in UTC: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. Numbers, *, lists, ranges and steps; at most every 5 minutes; never both day fields.

run.description: The job file, relative to <app>/jobs/ (for example nightly-check.js). It must resolve inside <app>/jobs/ and export an async run(ctx).

enabled.description: This job's own switch. It runs only if this, the profile's jobs.enabled are true and APLABS_JOBS_OFF is unset.
